scope: Read-only independent endpoint and closure analysis. All coordinates local to 1254 source image. No image or candidate edits.

immutableLeft.requirement: Keep these exact source pixels, including the original dark broad grout crossings.

lower.verdict: A continuous broad beveled grout must run from the immutable left edge to the existing heavy right diagonal as a T-junction.
lower.preserve: Keep the pre-existing heavy diagonal through the final T-junction continuous in both directions. Match the left dark core plus both bevel rims; do not taper into a hairline crack.
lower.incorrectRoute: The generated image instead reorganizes the whole slab and sends its major lower boundary to the corner around (690,790). That does not match the immutable incoming left grout at y857.

upper.closureConstraint: With the current upper guide hole [315,35,690,380], a connected route must join (315,193) to the fixed existing exit near (472,35). These endpoints imply slope about -1.0, while the source incoming and outgoing tangents are about -0.65 and -0.69. A single straight connector therefore introduces an angular change at each end.
upper.recommended: Expand the upper editable support and actual upper context to a sufficient stable intersection/anchor if straight regular paving is required. Under the current fixed footprint, only a visibly bent or smoothly varying polygonal slab edge can connect both endpoints; do not describe that as exact straight-line alignment.
upper.incorrectRoute: Do not move the immutable left cross-junction upward or substitute the old right y143 endpoint for the required left y193 crossing.

generationDisposition: Reject for composition: it shifts left grout/corners and invents elongated right-side slabs instead of preserving the immutable left endpoints.
guideAdvice: Cyan guide geometry may show the desired native-generated grout route, but must remain guide-only. The final accepted pixels should come from native image generation and be checked against immutable source borders.
mutations: Only this analysis JSON under the allowed review directory.
